column1: # The pieces NVIDIA's names for SASS are made of, read by whatever names a form of the part's .khw. Nothing here is
# compiled in. Every piece is spelled as NVIDIA's compiler spells it, so that what we write is held against what it
# A form is named by what the part answered of it, never by a listing: the kind of value its cases hold, the relation
# it answers, how many sources its fields hold, then each qualifier the part's answers read it into, each after a
# dot, in the order the rows of each kind stand below. IADD3 is an integer add of three sources; IADD3.X takes the
# carry an earlier one left; ISETP.GE.U32.AND compares as unsigned words and joins its flag to another. The kind is
# the row whose reads hold the relation, and a relation no kind row reads takes none: S2R, not IS2R.
